description:
Finding: generated webhook sensor modules exist and plugin availability can surface them, but non-poll events currently fall through to a no-op in Jido.Connect.JidoSensorRuntime.

Scope:
- Decide and implement the explicit contract for generated webhook sensors.
- Either add a webhook runtime path that delegates to provider webhook normalizers and emits Jido signals, or mark generated webhook sensors as metadata-only with docs and projection metadata.
- Keep provider-specific signature verification in provider packages.
- Add tests proving Slack/GitHub webhook trigger projections do not appear operational unless the runtime path is implemented.

Primary files:
- apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/jido/sensor_runtime.ex
- apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/jido/sensor_projection.ex
- apps/jido_connect_github/lib/jido_connect/github/webhook.ex
- apps/jido_connect_slack/lib/jido_connect/slack/webhook.ex

Acceptance:
- No silent no-op for webhook sensor events unless the projection explicitly declares metadata-only behavior.
- Docs clarify host responsibilities for webhook delivery, signature verification, idempotency, and signal emission.
title: Harden generated webhook sensor runtime contract
